title: Figure 16: Object Sightings by Reported Speed of Object with Evaluation Distribution
description: A vertical stacked bar on the left divides sightings into speed groups: Stationary (13.7%), Less than 100 mph (8.2%), 100–400 mph (10.9%), Over 400 mph (24.9%), Meteor-like (4.5%) and Speed not stated (37.8%). Dashed lines connect each group to a horizontal 0–100 percent bar showing its evaluation breakdown (Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown). Caption: "FIGURE 16 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY REPORTED SPEED OF OBJECT(S) WITH EVALUATION DISTRIBUTION FOR EACH SPEED GROUP"; drawing A-7494.
